rounds.note_en: Original-currency component of the same 2021 sustainability-linked promissory-note issuance. JENOPTIK AG standalone accounts disclose EUR350m and USD59m. The approximately EUR400m headline is a translated aggregate and is not a third event. Tranches had March and September 2021 value dates, with currency-specific timing undisclosed. Separate December syndicated facility is retained.
rounds.coverage_note_en: 2021 promissory issuance reconciled in original currencies. Historical financing review remains partial.

sources.title: JENOPTIK AG 2021 standalone accounts, liabilities note, page 12
